title: Children for the source tax tariff
purpose: Ask employees subject to source tax about each child, following the calculator's per-child logic, to decide which children count for the tariff digit and whether a single employee gets the H tariff.

stories.title: Ask each child's age status and household, only where the tariff needs it
stories.i_want: employees subject to source tax to say whether they have children and, for each child, whether it is a minor or of age and in first education, and whether it lives in their household
stories.so_that: Lonio can decide child by child whether the child counts for the tariff code, without asking anyone else about their children
stories.priority_reason: Lonio computes the tariff code instead of HR (D-001); without the child answers the child digit cannot be computed.

acceptance_criteria.title: Children question only for employees subject to source tax
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee is filling in the source tax step
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee is subject to source tax
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked, and must answer yes or no, whether they have biological or adopted children (for married employees and registered partners: children of the employee or of the spouses/partners); employees not subject to source tax are not asked about children at all. The answer is used for the source tax tariff code.

Swiss citizen living in Switzerland
Employee subject to source tax without children

acceptance_criteria.title: One block of questions per child
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee subject to source tax has answered that they have children
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee can add and remove children, and for each child is asked whether it is 'Minor', 'Of age and in first education' or 'Neither'; an answer is required for every child added.

examples.name: Employee with children

acceptance_criteria.title: A child that is neither a minor nor in first education does not count
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee subject to source tax has a child
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee answers 'Neither' for the child's age status
acceptance_criteria.then: no further question is asked about that child and the child does not count for the tariff code.

acceptance_criteria.title: Household question for minors and children in first education
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee subject to source tax has a child that is a minor or of age and in first education
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked, and must answer yes or no, whether the child lives in the same household.

stories.title: Ask custody and common household for a minor child living with the employee
stories.i_want: employees with a minor child in their household to state custody, common household with the other parent and, where relevant, alternating care
stories.so_that: the child is counted for the tariff digit, and as an H child for single employees, exactly as the calculator does
stories.priority_reason: Wrong child counting gives a wrong tariff code, which Lonio now owns instead of HR (D-001).

acceptance_criteria.title: Custody asked only for a minor child in the household
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee subject to source tax has a minor child
acceptance_criteria.when: the child lives in the same household
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked, and must answer, whether custody is 'Shared custody' or 'Sole custody'; it is not asked for a child outside the household or a child of age.

acceptance_criteria.title: Sole custody counts the child
acceptance_criteria.given: a minor child lives in the employee's household
acceptance_criteria.then: no further question is asked about the child; it counts for the tariff digit, and for an employee counting as single it counts as an H child.

acceptance_criteria.title: Shared custody with a common household with the other parent
acceptance_criteria.given: a minor child lives in the employee's household with shared custody
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee is asked, and must answer yes or no, whether they live in a common household with the child's other parent, and answers yes
acceptance_criteria.then: for an employee counting as married the child counts and nothing more is asked; for an employee counting as single the larger financial contributor decides: the employee - H child (inferred, see OQ-calculator-coverage); the other parent - the child does not count.

Single, common household, employee contributes more (inferred)

acceptance_criteria.title: Shared custody without a common household: alternating care
acceptance_criteria.given: a minor child lives in the employee's household with shared custody and the employee does not live with the other parent
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee is asked, and must answer yes or no, whether there is alternating care
acceptance_criteria.then: without alternating care the child does not count for a married employee and counts as an H child for a single employee; with alternating care the larger financial contributor decides: the other parent - the child does not count; the employee - the child counts (married) or counts as an H child (single). Rows not observed in the calculator are inferred and checked before go-live (see OQ-calculator-coverage).

stories.title: Ask custody and alternating care for a minor child not living with the employee
stories.i_want: employees with a minor child outside their household to state custody and alternating care, with the custody question worded for married or single employees as in the calculator
stories.so_that: such a child counts for the tariff only when the calculator would count it
stories.priority_reason: Wrong child counting gives a wrong tariff code, which Lonio now owns instead of HR (D-001).

acceptance_criteria.title: Custody question depends on the source tax civil status
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee subject to source tax has a minor child that does not live in their household
acceptance_criteria.then: an employee counting as married (married or registered partnership) is asked, yes or no, whether custody is shared; an employee counting as single (single, divorced, separated, widowed) is asked, yes or no, whether they have parental custody. Exactly one of the two is asked and must be answered.

acceptance_criteria.title: No custody: the child does not count
acceptance_criteria.given: a minor child does not live in the employee's household
acceptance_criteria.when: the married employee has no shared custody, or the single employee has no parental custody
acceptance_criteria.then: no further question is asked about the child and it does not count for the tariff code.

acceptance_criteria.title: Custody: alternating care and the larger contributor decide
acceptance_criteria.given: a minor child does not live in the employee's household and the employee has shared (married) or parental (single) custody
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee is asked, and must answer yes or no, whether there is alternating care
acceptance_criteria.then: without alternating care the child does not count (inferred); with alternating care and the employee as larger contributor the child counts (married) or counts as an H child (single); with the other parent as larger contributor it does not count (inferred). Inferred rows are checked before go-live (see OQ-calculator-coverage).

stories.title: Ask who contributes more to the child's maintenance
stories.i_want: the employee to say whether they or the other parent make the larger financial contribution to a child's maintenance, only where this decides the child result
stories.so_that: children in alternating care, and children of single employees living with both parents, are counted as the calculator counts them
stories.priority_reason: Decides whether the child counts and whether a single employee gets the H tariff (D-001).

acceptance_criteria.title: Larger contributor asked only where it decides the result
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee subject to source tax describes a child
acceptance_criteria.when: there is alternating care for the child, or the employee counts as single and lives with the child and the child's other parent in a common household
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked, and must answer, who makes the larger financial contribution: 'The employee' or 'The other parent'. A married employee living in a common household with the other parent is not asked; neither is anyone with no alternating care.

stories.i_want: employees with a child of age in first education to state whether they live with the other parent and whether they cover more than 50% of the child's maintenance
stories.so_that: such a child counts for the tariff only when the calculator would count it
stories.priority_reason: Wrong child counting gives a wrong tariff code (D-001).

acceptance_criteria.title: Child in the household: common household with the other parent
acceptance_criteria.given: a child of age in first education lives in the employee's household
acceptance_criteria.then: the employee is asked, and must answer yes or no, whether they live in a common household with the other parent; custody is not asked. With a common household the child counts for a married employee; for a single employee the larger contributor decides (the employee - H child, the other parent - does not count; both inferred, see OQ-calculator-coverage).

stories.title: Derive the child digit and the single-parent H tariff
stories.i_want: Lonio to derive the tariff code's child digit and, for single employees, the H tariff from the per-child results
stories.so_that: I no longer click through the calculator to find the tariff code; it is recorded for me from the employee's answers
stories.priority_reason: Replaces HR's manual calculator step (D-001); the digit and H letter are part of every tariff code.

acceptance_criteria.title: Child digit counts the children that count
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee subject to source tax has answered the child questions
acceptance_criteria.then: the child digit equals the number of children whose result is 'counts' or 'counts as H child' (e.g. three counting children of a married employee whose spouse works give C3Y); children that do not count add nothing; an employee without children gets 0. The result is recorded for HR.

Single, H child adds one (zh_source_tax_calculator/F-zh_source_tax_calculator-c53a22)
Child neither minor nor in education adds nothing (zh_source_tax_calculator/F-zh_source_tax_calculator-987091)

acceptance_criteria.title: H tariff for single employees with an H child
acceptance_criteria.given: an employee subject to source tax has answered the child questions
acceptance_criteria.when: the employee counts as single and at least one child counts as an H child
acceptance_criteria.then: the tariff letter is H (e.g. one child counting and one H child give H2N); a single employee whose children only count (not as H child) keeps tariff A; an employee counting as married never gets H.
